content.title: Validate dual-format documentation generation
content.description:
Spec: .agentic/specs/docs-generation.md

Validate the documentation generation setup after library-release completes configuration (issue mpctzf23nq).

Check:
1. 'bun run docs:html' generates complete HTML API docs to docs/html/ at repo root
2. 'bun run docs:md' generates complete Markdown API docs to docs/md/ at repo root
3. 'bun run docs' generates both formats
4. 'bun run docs:check' validates without writing files
5. Both formats include all public API (Tracker methods, types, errors)
6. Markdown output is concise — no breadcrumbs, no page headers, flat structure
7. 'bun run quality' still passes (typecheck, lint, test:coverage)
8. Old docs-html/ inside packages/library/ is removed
9. Content parity between HTML and Markdown (same API coverage)

Report any issues found. Do not fix — only report.
